m_Description: LocalizedString:eb3ea8cd-8723-43fe-9d9d-1a436cc4eb8d:To treat an affliction means to tend to a single diseased or poisoned character. Make a Lore (Religion) check. If your check exceeds the DC of the affliction, the affliction is removed. You can treat each character only once per day.
